name: Lasso Regression
learningObjectives: Understand L1 regularization and automatic feature selection
Learn how Lasso sets coefficients to exactly zero
Apply Lasso for feature selection in high-dimensional data
Interpret sparse models created by Lasso

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a dataset to train on

controls.label: Alpha (Regularization Strength)
controls.tooltip: Controls regularization strength. Higher values perform more feature selection.

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Controls how quickly the model learns.

visualizations.title: Data & Lasso Regression Line
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing the data points and the fitted regression line with L1 regularization

visualizations.title: Training Loss
visualizations.description: Line chart showing how the loss decreases during training

visualizations.title: Coefficients
visualizations.description: Bar chart showing coefficient values (some may be exactly zero)

metrics.name: Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Average squared difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: Root Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Square root of MSE, in the same units as the target

metrics.name: R² Score
metrics.description: Proportion of variance explained by the model

metrics.name: Mean Absolute Error
metrics.description: Average absolute difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: Non-Zero Features
metrics.description: Number of features with non-zero coefficients

metrics.name: L1 Norm of Weights
metrics.description: Sum of absolute values of coefficients
